content: JetBrains Mono alternatives for industrial dashboard aesthetic: Geist Mono (Vercel, mechanical/dense letterforms, pairs with Geist Sans); Space Mono (most characterful, retro-technical detailing, good for headings/brand moments as a deliberate style choice); Departure Mono (pixelated retro-tech, strong for display/branding, less suited to body/data legibility); IBM Plex Mono remains cited as unbeatable weight range for data-heavy corporate interfaces. Modern monospaces increasingly ship as variable fonts (single file, multiple weight axes) e.g. Geist Mono, JetBrains Mono, Recursive.
